tests.title: English grammar correction
tests.task: Correct the English sentence, explain the error in Arabic, and provide two correct examples.
tests.input: Yesterday I go to the market.
tests.expected_correction: Yesterday I went to the market.

result.correction: Yesterday I went to the market.

tests.notes: The model correctly identified the past-tense error, explained the correction in Arabic, and provided two correct examples.

tests.title: Arabic-English code-switching correction
tests.task: Correct the English errors in a mixed Arabic-English sentence and explain the corrections in Arabic.
tests.input: Yesterday I was going to الجامعة, but I forget my book at home.

result.correction: Yesterday I was going to the university, but I forgot my book at home.

issues: The Arabic explanation contained an unexpected Chinese character: م冠
tests.notes: The model understood the mixed Arabic-English input and corrected the English errors, but the Arabic explanation showed a language-quality issue and the captured response appeared incomplete.

tests.title: Natural bilingual tutoring conversation
tests.task: Act as an English tutor, understand the mixed Arabic-English message, identify English mistakes, explain corrections in Arabic, respond naturally, and provide encouraging advice.
tests.input: أنا اليوم كنت في الجامعة and I had a presentation. بصراحة I was very nervous because I did not practice enough. بعدين my friend told me to relax, but I still make many mistakes while I was speaking. What do you think I should do next time?
issues: The model incorrectly treated natural Arabic-English code-switching as a problem and suggested using only one language.
The response reached the maximum output token limit and was truncated.
tests.notes: The model demonstrated good bilingual understanding and English correction ability, but it did not fully align with the intended code-switching use case and the response was truncated.
